svg.text: ROUND 345 · 🏆 345-FAQ, BRK-700 & 1,502-ASSERTION HISTORIC MILESTONE · CHAPTER 11 CLAIMS (EPIQ / KROLL / STRETTO) & DIP WATERFALL
Corporate Restructuring (Chapter 11), Claims Audit (Kroll/Epiq) & Waterfall AI Agent Security FAQ
§363 Stalking-Horse Valuation & Liquidation Model Air-Gap + Absolute Priority Lock vs. Form 410 Claim Injection & Rule 3001(e) Wire Fraud (BRK-699 / BRK-700)
🚨 1. Top 3 Chapter 11 Restructuring & Claims Threat Vectors
① Form 410 Claim Injection Leaking §363 Reserve Bid (BRK-699)
• Adversarial distressed creditor Proof of Claim (Form 410 PDF)
embeds indirect prompt injection in invoice rider
• Coerces Agent into reading confidential §363 stalking-horse
reserve floors & Chapter 7 liquidation waterfalls (restricted-budget)
② Priority Reclassification of General Unsecured Claims (BRK-699)
• Upgrades disputed General Unsecured Claim (GUC) to superpriority
§503(b)(9) 20-day administrative priority & waives omnibus objection
• Forces 100¢-on-the-dollar payout instead of 8¢ GUC recovery pool
• Impact: Violates 11 U.S.C. §1129 Absolute Priority Rule & DIP covenants
③ Spoofed Rule 3001(e) Claim Transfer Wire Fraud (BRK-700)
• Forged Rule 3001(e) Notice of Transfer of Claim to distressed fund
• Overwrites verified Claims Register payee IBAN in trust-registry
• Triggers unauthorized $5,000 plan distribution wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Bankruptcy estate trust theft & fiduciary liability
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Chapter 11 Claims Defense-in-Depth
Gate 1: Form 410 Sanitization & Typed Claim Slot Extraction
• Strips free-text rider instructions; extracts typed claim slots
(creditor EIN, goods receipt timestamp, POD BOL, claimed class)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: §363 Valuation & Liquidation Waterfall Air-Gap
• Chief Restructuring Officer (CRO) §363 reserve prices, DIP
covenant buffers & recovery models isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic §503(b)(9) 20-Day Window & Priority Lock
• Hardcoded ERP receipt check in [Petition_Date - 20d, Petition_Date);
AI cannot reclassify priority or waive omnibus claim objections
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% unauthorized priority block)
Gate 4: Read-Only Claims Register & 21-Day Rule 3001(e) Hold
• Locks Claims Register IBANs in trust-registry (tool-allowlist +
fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Restructuring & Claims Security Options Compared:
A. Capability Broker + §363 Air-Gap + Priority Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-699/700 | U.S. Trustee & Court Order ready
B. Native Kroll / Epiq / Stretto Portal RBAC + Docket Logs
⚠ Fails when shared reconciliation bot is hijacked via Form 410
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to Petition Date cutoffs, §503(b)(9) windows & priority
D. Manual Restructuring Associate Review of 50,000+ Claims
✕ $1,000+/hr professional fees drain creditor recovery pool
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 345 · 1,502 Assertions!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows priority upgrade, leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks §363 stalking-horse floor read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks GUC-to-503(b)(9) upgrade (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks recovery waterfall egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks Claims Register
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,000 distribution wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 345 · 🏆 345 FAQs, BRK-700 & 1,502 Assertions Milestone!)
✅ 1. Valuation & Waterfall Air-Gap: Isolate §363 stalking-horse reserve bids, DIP covenants & liquidation models in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic Petition-Date Cutoff: Enforce ERP goods-receipt timestamp check in [Petition_Date - 20d, Petition_Date) for §503(b)(9)
✅ 3. Court Order Hash & CRO FIDO2: Require signed Court Order hash + CRO FIDO2 sign-off for priority upgrades & plan distributions
